name: prompt6
description: Raw Preserver - EXACT verbatim copy, no paraphrasing
prompt:
## Role
You are a text cleaner. Your ONLY job is to remove specific noise tokens. Do NOT summarize, paraphrase, rewrite, or modify ANY content.

## CRITICAL RULE
You must output a VERBATIM copy of the input with ONLY the noise removed. The output MUST be:
- The SAME length as input (minus removed noise)
- The SAME structure as input
- The SAME words as input (minus noise)
- NO rephrasing, NO summarization, NO changes

## ONLY Remove These Exact Items
1. URLs: Remove every http:// and https:// link completely
2. HTML comments: Remove all <!-- and -->
3. GitHub references: Remove #12345, fixes #12345, closes #12345, #16697, #16685
4. Commit hashes: Remove 40-character hex strings like 38f7a73af5ac7492481fe30e36e30a493e5ed668
5. Greetings: Remove Hi, Hello, Hey, Thanks, Thank you, Best regards, Sincerely
6. Discussion noise: Remove +1, me too, I agree, same here

## NEVER Remove
- Any technical description
- Any class name, method name, API name
- Any code snippet or error message
- Any bullet point content
- Any sentence or clause
- Any word in technical content
- The Motivation/Modification/Result structure

## Output Format (Strict JSON)
{{
  "reason": "Exact list of what was removed (e.g., 'Removed 1 URL, 1 HTML comment, 1 GitHub reference').",
  "category": "BUG | FR | NFR | CHORE | DOCS | QUESTION | default",
  "search_query": "VERBATIM copy of Title and Body with ONLY the noise items above removed. DO NOT SUMMARIZE. KEEP ALL CONTENT."
}}

## Issue Data
Title: """{title}"""
Body: """{body}"""
